headline: Colonials Breach Callahan's Passage as Clashes Flare Across Northern Fronts
war_summary: Colonial forces have pierced Warden lines in Callahan’s Passage, reclaiming a strategic foothold and breaking the brief Warden monopoly amidst three fresh exchanges between Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage. Fighting across Palantine Berm remains ferocious, recording three base transfers over the last two hours as the contest over The Pippeli Stones and Leiri Hermanni keeps Warden holdings at six to the Colonials' one. To the west, Nevish Line reignited with two recent base shifts, leaving the sector split between four Warden garrisons, three Colonial positions, and one neutral ruin. Mooring County recorded another exchange at The Wind Hills, where intense fighting generated over seven hundred casualties in two hours while Colonials hold their solitary outpost. In contrast, base transitions have ceased in Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf, though artillery and trench engagements continue to bleed both armies, particularly across Weathered Expanse where over five hundred men fell in two hours. Kuura Strand and the southern heartlands remain entirely pacified.
